findings.issue: Matched hydration events discarded recovered source personas.
findings.disposition: Fixed: explicit source reconciliation projects recovered roles onto matched events; shared discovery by three reviewers.

findings.issue: Concurrent cache invalidation could turn known live personas into Unknown.
findings.disposition: Fixed: trace and persona evidence are returned together in one immutable cached snapshot.

findings.issue: Existing database-wide invalidation can rebuild unchanged active-session traces.
findings.disposition: Accepted pre-existing debt: database-wide invalidation may reread unchanged histories. Owner: live-service maintenance; follow-up per-session invalidation.

findings.issue: Orphan promotion lacked an explicit parent-link retention assertion.
findings.disposition: Fixed test gap: existing orphan-tree builder test now asserts retained parent_id and input ancestry; no production defect demonstrated.

findings.issue: Failed metadata reads could erase a matched committed persona.
findings.disposition: Fixed: failed metadata reads retain the OpenCode baseline and independent Codex enrichment. Distinct defect discovered during data re-review.

findings.issue: Reviewer proposed erasing known ledger roles when optional live persona evidence is absent.
findings.disposition: Refuted: absent optional live evidence does not invalidate a known accepted ledger persona; explicit source evidence still overrides. No code change.
